mentions.name: Million Timer
mentions.description: This app provides time-blocking and invoice generation for freelancers, aimed at those who hate tracking time but need to do it anyway. It is currently in alpha with beta testing open.
mentions.problem: Freelancers hate tracking time but need to do it anyway.
mentions.audience: Freelancers who need to track time even though they dislike doing it.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on Million Timer (https://milliontimer.com), a time-blocking and invoice generation app for freelancers who hate tracking time but need to do it anyway.

While it's still in alpha phase, please feel free to beta test and roast it.
